notes: Access: same as bs7 - plain HTTP/curl_cffi and headless Playwright both hit DataDome 403/CAPTCHA on HTML pages (sitemaps/robots.txt were fine, 200); robots.txt has no Claude-specific Disallow, so used Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) for actual PLP content. Scoped to the anthrohome (Home & Furniture) storefront. Investigation: (1) Fetched anthrohome/categories_sitemap.xml (453 URLs) and grepped for clearance/clearances/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of/discontinu - ZERO matches anywhere. The only markdown-related family found is 9 'collection-*sale*' URLs: collection-candle-sale, collection-freshly-cut-sale, collection-sale-house-home, collection-sale-rugs, collection-decor-sale, collection-sale-art-mirrors, collection-limited-time-sale, collection-sale-bedding, collection-sale-kitchen-dining - all named 'Sale', never Clearance/Outlet. (2) Opened collection-sale-house-home (H1 'Home & Furniture Sale', 361 products) and collection-limited-time-sale (breadcrumb 'Sale > Limited-Time Sale', H1 'Limited-Time Sale', 1084 products): every discounted item on both carries a 'Limited Time!' tag, and the page's own body copy frames it purely as temporary savings ('Anthropologie furniture sale... look no further than our decor sale') with no permanence/clearance/outlet/end-of-line language anywhere - this is squarely the CRITICAL Sale-vs-Clearance exclusion case the brief describes (generic temporary promotional sale, explicitly time-boxed), not ambiguous. The remaining 7 sale-* URLs follow the identical collection-sale-<category> URL/nav pattern (mirroring the verified collection-new-<category> New-Arrivals family) and were not each individually opened, but nothing in the sitemap, nav, or search suggests any of them carry different (clearance) taxonomy language. (3) Site search on the Home storefront for 'clearance' did not return a distinct result set - it silently redirected to https://www.anthropologie.com/sale-all (site-wide 'All Sale | Best Sale Products', 4097 products, mixing apparel/beauty/home), confirming the site has no separate Clearance search concept at all, only generic Sale. Conclusion: this site has no genuine Clearance/Outlet/Final-Clearance/Last-Chance/End-of-Line PLP - only temporary, explicitly 'Limited-Time' Sale pages, which the brief instructs to exclude rather than count as Clearance.
